answer: A hundred keys, one rule: Boot maker riding boot proof pegged at the welt shed, and the rule is satisfied only by each riding boot is a season of logged shoe fittings plus a signed shoe record, so a. Charge the same fare to every key and the farm's fare is 52371 POA for 529 keys; the honest agent's fare is 99. Read the jade and you know the issuer. Read the pearl and you know the amount. Read the meadow and you know the year. The gate keeps no grudges and no favourites: it keeps proofs, and the farm has none.
